## 0.1.0

First stable release of the client. It contains the changes from the 0.1.0 prereleases below.
No changes since 0.1.0-alpha4.

## 0.1.0-alpha4

### Added

- `KommunikasjonApiException` and `GetKommunikasjonProblemDetails()` (`KommunikasjonProblemDetails`:
  title, detail, status, validation errors, trace ID, Altinn error code).

### Changed

- Failed requests (adapter and `KommunikasjonApiClient`) now throw `KommunikasjonApiException`, whose
  message names the HTTP method and URL, the status code, and the problem details the API returned
  (title, detail, validation errors and trace ID), or the response body (truncated to 4096
  characters) when it isn't a problem document. Before, the message was the generic
  `Exception of type '…ValidationProblemDetails' was thrown.`, validation errors were only reachable as
  untyped nodes, and the body was lost for status codes the API spec doesn't declare.
  **Breaking:** `catch (ProblemDetails)` / `catch (ValidationProblemDetails)` no longer match; the
  generated exception is now the `InnerException`. `catch (ApiException)` and `ResponseStatusCode`
  work as before.

## 0.1.0-alpha3

### Added

- External references: `CreateMessageRequest.ExternalReferences` (`ExternalReferenceRequest` with the
  string enum `ExternalReferenceType`), `CreateMessageRequestFactory.WithExternalReference` and
  client-side validation in `ExternalReferenceRules` (at most 10, values 1–1000 characters). Mapped to
  Altinn's correspondence external references.
- Attachment display names: optional `MessageAttachment.DisplayName`, sent as `attachmentMetadata` in
  the multipart payload (matched by order) and shown in Altinn instead of the file name.
  `AttachmentRules.MaxDisplayNameLength` (255).
- The stub resolves `GetMessageStatusAsync` and `GetCorrespondenceDetailsAsync` by message ID or by
  idempotent key. The API is expected to support lookup by idempotent key in a later release.

## 0.1.0-alpha2

### Added

- Kiota-generated `KommunikasjonApiClient` for the Kommunikasjon `/api` surface.
- `IKommunikasjonAdapter`: send messages (JSON or multipart with PDF attachments), read status and
  correspondence details, manage subscriptions.
- `AddKommunikasjonClient`: base URL derived from the host environment and
  `KommunikasjonEnvironment` (`Production`, `Dev`, `Local`, `Stub`), standard resilience (retries
  `POST /api/meldinger` thanks to the idempotent key) and a `Kommunikasjon` health check.
- `Stub` environment with an in-memory adapter returning dummy data.
